/mchi ma'i rgyun ni dbyar gyi chu ltar brdol// don snying nang khrol phyi ru 'thon snyam pa'i// 'o dod snying nas 'bod pa rjes gsan nam// kye ma 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// gdul bya bdag sogs ma dag snang ba la// khyod sku pad+mo'i gnyen gang 'bar ba can// nub ri rtse mthon dag las pha rol son// 'dzam gling mun pa'i dmag gis gang bar snyam// bdag cag skyabs med dpung bral 'jigs par mthong*// 'on kyang rje nyid rtag brtan 'gyur ba med// lhun grub 'od gsal brjod bral 'dus ma byas// mi g.yo blo 'das sems nyid ngo bo'i skur// gdod nas gnas pa'i gtam 'di yang nas yang*// yongs 'dzin gang de'i gsung las rnyed gyur pas// rang sems 'du 'bral med pa'i bla ma mchog /sku gsum rnam dbyer 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid// de dngos de la mchod cing gsol ba'i tshul// thabs shes rten 'brel 'khor lo 'di bskor bas// gdod nas bla ma'i rang zhal kun mthong shog /de ltar rje btsun 'di nyid mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i nyin de nas/ gzhir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun grangs mang ba dag gis gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i mchod 'bul dang*/ gnyis med kyi don mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs ldan gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod 'bul gdung gi drung nyid du 'khod pa dang*/ chos lung ba'i tshogs pa dpon slob 'khor dang bcas kyang*/ sman lha'i mchod chog gnang ste/ zhag bcu'i bar du chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe/ sku mdangs kyang sngar bas bzang zhing*/ me tog gi char 'ja' 'od gur khang ni nyin mtshan bye brag med par gyur/ sku gdung rin po che nyid ji ltar zhugs kyi bar mi ma yin gyis skor ba byed pa'i sgra dang*/ ri bong gi gzugs kyis phyag 'tshal ba dag ni kun gyis mthong ba dang thos par gyur to// tshes bco lnga'i nangs mo nyi shar gyi rtse la/

bla ma rdor 'dzin pa'i mthong snang la rje nyid rigs lnga'i cod pan dang ldan pas/ seng ge sngo skya srab med pa zhig la bcibs te/ dge 'dun du ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ shar phyogs su phebs pa dang*/ bla ma 'dan ma la ni gzims chung dang mdun ri'i bar 'ja' 'od kyis sbrel ba'i ri'i rtse mor/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur khyim che ba gcig la chung ba bcu gsum gyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ thub dbang la 'khor byang sems nyan rang dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang de ga'i ngang las/ zhabs drung nyid 'ja' 'od kyi lam de'i steng du phebs pa'i 'khor dge 'dun du ma dang bcas/ bla ma rang la bka' lung mang rab gnang ste/ yar phebs te thub dbang dang gnyis su med par gyur pa dang*/ bdag kyang*/ yid mya ngan zug rngus non bzhin par/ rab gsal zhes par gnas pa la/ de'i nang na/ nyi ma shar ba'i 'od dang mtshungs par/ bdag gi snying khar 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga pa zhig zug byung ba la/ cung zad song nas/ 'od kyi sna nyid tshur 'gril te/ bdag nyid la thim pa rnams byung ba dang dus mnyam par thugs dam grol bar gyur pa'i tshe/ sku gdung rin po che zangs kyi za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ de las mi 'gyang bar/ sde pa nyid kyis dgos su khur bzhes pa'i spur ston bzang zhing rgya che ba dang*/ phag mo nas drung chen rin po che dpon g.yog kyang phebs pa'i bka' bkod dang gzhi mtshungs par/ slar sde pa rang gis phyag len du btab pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag gsum las grangs lhag pa'i tshogs mang dang*/ skye bo 'jig rten pa'i tshogs khri phrag gi grangs las 'das pa rnams la 'gyed chen dang tshogs pa mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ gang 'tshams kyi 'bul ba sa dkar rnying gsum gyi dgon sde che chung rnams su mang 'gyed rnams kyang*/ dpangs mtho bar grub cing*/ khyad par mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i gong*/ 'dan bla ma kun dga' grags pa sgam por 'byon par zhus pa la/

rje'i zhal nas re zhig nye skor 'di rang du sdod/ dus la bab par nged kyi don bsgrub dgos pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ zhes bka' phebs pa dang mtshungs par/ bla ma dpon slob ri pa grangs mang ba rnams/ gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti ser gser 'bum bzhengs pa dang*/ ma pham du mtsho mchod 'bul bar/ mkho ba'i yo byad du ma dang bcas stag ram pas gtsos pa'i ri pa tshan gcig bal yul 'phags pa shing kun du gser gdugs 'degs pa dang*/ tsā ri trar ye shes kyi 'khor lor/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba rnams kyang*/ so sor longs spyod dngos po dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa brdzangs shing*/ mdor na thugs mchog zhi ba chen po'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams ni/ da lta'i bar du'ang rgyun 'chad med pa kho na nyid do// de dag gi tshe ngo mtshar ba'i snang brnyan du mas/ skye bo mda' lnga'i dbang du gyur pa rnams kyang*/ yang dag gi nges pa rnyed tshul ni/ dgun dus der kyang*/ sa chu thams cad dros te rtsi shing lo ma me tog ches cher rgyas pa kun gyis mthong ba dang*/ dgung zhag ma rdzogs kyi bar/ gdung gi drung du mar me phul ba rnams kyang*/ zhag grangs mang bar 'dzin pa sogs/ gzhan yang khyad par du 'phags pa'i rtags phul du phyin pa rnams ni thams cad kyi mngon du gyur pa'o// de nas slar yang*/ rje nyid kyi bka'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su/ tsan+dan dkar dmar las grub pa'i thub pa'i mdzad bcu dang*/ rje nyid kyi sku 'dra rin po che tshogs dbus su bzhugs pa sman dar dag las grub pa dang*/ gzims mal gyi gser sku gong ma rnams las brgya dpangs che ba grub cing*/ khyad par sku gdung rin po che nyid bzhugs pa'i yul dngul las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi rnam pa bsgrub pa'i mdun pas/ nged cag rnams/ a la dang*/ rngod/ rgyal shod rnams su/ rje nyid kyi bu slob grwa rtsa dang bcas pa rnams kyis bskul te/ phyin pa'i tshe rin po che'i bye brag rnams kyang 'bad med du char ltar bab par gyur cing*/

bdag kyang sa phyogs de dang de dag tu 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i 'tshe ba mang bar gyur kyang*/ rje nyid la gsol ba btab pas 'phral du zhi zhing*/ lam bar du 'jigs pa'i nyen dang bral bar zla ba bdun gyi khongs su son te/ sbyangs pa kun kyang don dang ldan pa ni rje nyid kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs mtshungs pa med pa'i dpal gyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar bas/ rang gzhan ma lus pa'i don gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin par gyur pa ni/ slar yang rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyi bka'i drin du mngon no// de ltar nged cag kun/ mkho ba'i dngos po ji snyed mchis pa kun kyang*/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan nyid kyis khur du bzhes te/ thog mar dngul gdung rin po che 'dzam gling rgyan mchog dang*/ mchod rdzas gser dngul gyi ting*/ maṇ+ḍal/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam sgo mang gi gser gdugs gser thog dang de'i dbu thog tu gser gdugs/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dngul gar lugs las grub pa/ gser 'phru rnams kyang gegs med du grub pa'i rgyu rnams ni/ a la rngod sogs rang re'i phyogs mtha'i bu slob rnams kyis phul ba'i dngul las/ dngos dang bsgyur ba kho na nyid du bskrun pas zad mi shes par gyur to// gzhan yang rje btsun dam pa 'di yi sku gdung gi cha las thon pa'i chab ser ril bu dang*/ gdung tsha btab par gyur pa rnams las byon pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i grwa slob rnams kyi lag tu phyin pa/ ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga dang*/ gdung sha rī raṃ ram/ dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa rnams ni shin tu gsal zhing mang ba dag 'byung ba bzhi'i rkyen gyis mi rdzi bar byon pa dang*/ ril bu rnams kyang ring bsrel ltar 'phel bar gyur pa yang bgrang ba'i spyod yul las 'das so// de ltar sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad kyi dpe las yongs su 'das pa'i dpal ldan bla ma 'di ni/

slar thub pa chen po nyid mi yi yul du phebs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i mdzad pa dang cho 'phrul gyi sgo thabs du mas/ bstan pa rin po che ches cher dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa las/ grwa slob bu chen gyi tshogs nam mkha'i skar grangs ltar mang zhing grags che ba dpag tu med pa zhig mchis par gyur na'ang*/ 'dir che long tsam smos par bgyi na/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mang du thos pas mdo rgyud don gyi bstan bcos gsal bar mdzad pa'i dkon mchog rin chen pa dang*/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub cing*/ bdud bzhi'i dpung las rab tu rgyal ba'i grub chen don grub rnam rgyal ba dang*/ bsam gtan mchog gi mal du bzhugs shing*/ gtum mo ye shes mchog gi me la dro ba'i ngar 'dzin zhig pa'i grub chen blo gros dpal ldan pa dang*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs su gyur pa'i rje btsun 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ba dang*/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i mkhan chen mchog rab pa dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen rnam rgyal mgon po dri med sde dang*/ gsang sngags mchog gi don kun grub cing*/ chen po gsum gyi 'dzin pa zhig pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ rgyal ba mchog gi bstan pa'i lam du 'dzud pa'i lam mkhan chen po gyur pa'i yon tan ma lus pas brgyan pa'i bstan pa ba dang*/ legs pa rin chen/ lhun po bkra shis pa dang gzhan yang rang re rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba la mos pa phul du phyin zhing dbang 'byor ba'i sgru sgang bla ma tshul khrims 'od zer ba dang*/ bsod nams rgya mtsho ba/ gdan sa chen po nyid kyi lugs gnyis la khur gyis brjid cing rigs rus kyi mtho ba'i slob dpon pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen pa dang*/ chos sgo ba dpal 'byor grags pa/ gling kha dar rgyas rtse'i sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i gtso bo bla ma rin chen rgya mtsho ba dang*/

gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po cig car rdor 'dzin pa sogs mtha'i bu chen rnams ni bgrang bas mi lang kyang*/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor ba'i 'bri gung paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ thos bsam sgom pa'i ring lugs gsal bar mdzad pa'i mdo sde rab 'byams pa blo gros rgya mtsho sogs rje btsun 'di nyid kyi bu chen dang slob ma'i tshogs rang gzhan gyi don ma lus pa 'bad med du grub cing*/ dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu stsol bar nus pa rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu nyid do// //

de ltar rmongs pa tshu rol mthong ba'i rnam par thar pa rnams kyang gang gis blo yis phyogs gcig tu spobs par su yis nus te/ 'on kyang bdag nyid kyis mthong ba dang thos pa'i rnam par thar pa dag dang*/ gong du smos pa'i bu chen de rnams kyis sbyar ba'i rnam thar yi ge'i ris su bris pa rnams la gzhi byas shing*/ gong 'og gi rim pa cung zad bsgrigs te/ lcags mo yos kyi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i dus tshes dge ba la dpal 'bri gung gi bla brang mtshe'u khar/ snyoms las pa rat+na'i ming can gyis bris pa'o/// / oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal sras mdzad pa ltar/ skyob pa'i zhing 'dir skyob pa gnyis pa nyid// ngo mtshar las kyang ngo mtshar bkod pa'i sku// thabs tshul ma nges thabs rnams ji snyed kyis// dpag med mdzad pas dpag yas 'gro ba sgrol// sku gsum dbyer med sku 'di'i snang tshul ni// gang gis brjod kyang gang gā'i chu rgyun ltar// zad med rgyun ldan zad mi shes pa yi// rnam thar rgya mtsho rnam pa'i bye brag ni// bdag lta'i rmongs pa bdag gis ji ltar rtogs// 'on kyang bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las// skra rtse'i cha tsam brjod gyur de la'ang*// bsod nams bgrang yas tshad bzung ma mchis pas// bdag gzhan kun snyoms yon tan 'thob pa'i blos// gus pa'i yid kyis bris pa'i dge 'dis mtshon// 'gro kun dge ba byas dang byed 'gyur dang*// bgyid dngos rang bzhin yod pa'i dge rnams kyis// 'gro kun rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /kun dgas bris pa'i dge ba des// bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med shog// /shū bhaṃ/
